name: noteFx
meaning: 16-slot music-note emitter with inline storage: the factory sets slotPool = +0xa0, particles = +0x160, count (+0x9d) = 0x10; flags +0x9e bit 0 = active

name: sam
meaning: first Sam (class 1) found by Scenaric_FindByClass at Init; receives msg 0x481 within 300 units; NULL disables every effect (and the 0x1D broadcast)

name: homePos
meaning: spawn position (Init; msg 9 arg 1); Reset returns here when IN_WORLD

name: playSound
meaning: handle of the tune 0x25 (LOOP|POSITIONAL|NO_RETRIGGER), started by msg 0x15; stopped by every Flute_SetState

name: state
meaning: FluteState: 0 world, 1 held (silent; notes in flight age out), 2 playing
